bug_info.bug_desc: The decoder always_comb block does not assign a default value to the intermediate tinst signal. When the hypervisor extension is enabled, tinst is only assigned in selected decode branches, while other instruction paths can leave it without a defined combinational value. Since tinst is later forwarded into instruction_o.ex.tinst, this incomplete assignment can create an unintended combinational dependency or loop in some tool flows and can propagate stale or undefined trap-instruction metadata.
bug_info.fix_hint: Assign tinst a default value at the beginning of the decoder always_comb block before the opcode-specific decode logic. This ensures tinst is driven on every combinational path, eliminating the unintended loop or undefined dependency while preserving branch-specific tinst overrides.
